title: Epic Praise of the Panth and the Rise of Charhat Singh

blocks.text: The Panth is praised in epic language that compares the Sikhs to the Yadavas and treats Guru-guided struggle as the power that breaks the Giljis and humbles arrogant Turks. The page uses that elevated frame to argue that Sikh victories belong to a sacred historical pattern rather than to chance alone.

It then narrows from the collective to a single rising leader, celebrating Charhat Singh for the wounds and hardships he has already endured in battle. His renown grows precisely because his body shows the cost of struggle instead of the comfort of easy command.

By the end, admirers speak blessings that he would become sovereign over a wide dominion. The page therefore works as both praise-poetry for the Panth and a political anointing of Charhat Singh's future stature.
